W.note: Three clearly different curves, including an anticipation pop, shown as small loops with one global pause, no per-curve values panel, and no reduced-motion handling.

X.note: The strongest presentation with live graph markers, per-card copy, Play once and reduced-motion support, but the three curves are nearly identical so the set does not read as distinct.

Y.note: Clear per-curve graphs, readouts, Play once and reduced-motion handling, with a visible 5 percent kick curve that gives the set its only real punch, though punchy-sticky and sticky-settle are close to duplicates.

Z.note: The script throws a ReferenceError (blurbs is read before its const declaration), so the page renders blank at desktop, mobile and in all frames, though the declared curves would have been distinct.
